title: Every flag an adapter maps to a request needs a test that asserts the request it sends
rule: When a CLI subcommand or an MCP tool turns flags or arguments into an fm-api request (a scope, a mode, kept versus removed folders), test every flag on the adapter: run the command with that flag and assert the exact request field it produced, for example the request the plan echoes with --json, or a call recorded by the mock. Give paired flags different values (keep and remove) so a swap fails. A test that runs the command without the flag, or a unit test of another adapter's own mapping, leaves the mapping untested.
rationale: E56.9 (#669): fm duplicates plan mapped --keep-folder/--remove-folder, --set, --source and --folder to a CleanupScope, but no test passed a scope flag, so swapping keep and remove (trash the folder the user asked to keep) passed every test.
